name: Chasing
source:
Sandra is a sixteen year old girl who hates her parents but has a brother complex. Her life gets turned upside down when she meets the mysterious Darmuid claiming to be sent to protect her from demons.

[From [url=https://www.facebook.com/ChasingVisual]Facebook[/url]]
translation:
桑德拉是一个十六岁的女孩，她讨厌父母，但有兄弟情结。当她遇到神秘的达穆德（Darmuid），声称是被派来保护她免受恶魔侵害时，她的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

[来自[url=https://www.facebook.com/ChasingVisual]Facebook[/url]]
